title: Open Mic: Demo Night (1 class)
summary: A night of demos from people building with Deepgram and Pipecat, then an open mic. Food and drinks included.
detail: Welcome to the Deepgram Collab Hub at 505 Howard. A few minutes on Deepgram and what’s coming next, then demos from the community. The demo board below is live: projects that use Deepgram or Pipecat go first. Building with voice on something else? Add yourself too, and you’ll come up after them if there’s time.
outcome: You’ve seen what people are building with voice AI right now, met the builders, and know what’s coming to the Hub next.
artifact: A list of new voice projects and the people behind them, plus sign-ups for the next labs.
prereqs: Demoing? Your laptop with the project running, and a charger
Deepgram and Pipecat demos go first; other voice projects go after, if there’s time

slides.title: Welcome to 505 Howard
bullets: Eat the food. Drink the beer. That’s what it’s here for.
This is Open Mic: Demo Night with Deepgram
Wi-Fi is on the screen, demos start in a few minutes
slides.note: Welcome everyone to the Deepgram Collab Hub. Point at the food and drinks before anything else.

slides.title: Activate your Moose helper
bullets: Go to console.deepgram.com and sign up. It’s free, with $200 of credit and no card needed
Open API Keys, then Create a New API Key. Name it demo-dec1, then copy it
Open tonight’s lesson on dgeventhub.com and paste your key in the box at the top
Say hi to your Moose. Missed a demo, or want to reach someone who demoed? Ask him
slides.note: Give the room a minute to do this before moving on. The Moose runs on each person’s own key.

slides.title: How tonight goes
bullets: A few minutes on Deepgram and why we do this
What’s coming up: one more build night this month, and two labs next year
Demos: about 10 minutes each
Open mic: if there’s time, any voice project can jump up after the Deepgram and Pipecat demos
Then hang out, eat, drink, meet people

slides.title: Sign up to demo, and ask questions
bullets: The demo board is on tonight’s lesson page, right under these slides
Want to demo? Scroll to “Add your demo,” fill in the short form, then press “Add me to the board”
Deepgram and Pipecat projects go first. Other voice projects go after, if there’s time
Got a question for someone? Find their demo on the board and press “Send a question”
Type it, or press 🎤 to say it out loud. Your Moose key turns your voice into text
Ask anytime, during a demo or after. I’ll read the questions out when the demo ends
slides.note: Show the board on screen while you explain this. Saying a question out loud needs the Moose key from slide 2; typing works without it.

slides.title: What Deepgram makes
bullets: Speech to text: Flux and Nova hear people in real time, and Flux knows when you’ve finished talking
Text to speech: Aura and Flux voices that sound like people, fast enough for a live conversation
Voice Agent API: listen, think and talk back over one connection
Works with the tools builders already use, like Pipecat, Vapi and LiveKit
slides.note: Keep it short. The point is: we make the ears and the voice for voice apps.

slides.title: Voice AI fits anywhere people talk
bullets: Phone agents that answer, book and follow up
Video games where you talk to the characters
Robots, toys and gadgets you talk to
Avatars and digital humans
Captions on glasses, wearables and accessibility tools
Call centers, meeting notes, medical scribes

slides.title: Why we do demo nights
bullets: A chance to see the different ways people are using Deepgram
Hear about each project from the person who built it
Ask questions and meet other people building with voice
Got something of your own? There’s an open mic at the end for any voice project, if there’s time
Coming soon: a voice night open to every voice project

slides.title: Our upcoming events are posted below these slides
bullets: Level Up Your Phone Agent
A really fun Christmas event
An event with Women in Robotics
Luma links are below the slides
It’s demo time now!
slides.note: Level Up is Dec 8, Women in Robotics is Dec 15, Call Santa is Dec 16. Then hand over to the first demo.

flow.title: Tonight’s demo board
flow.note: Live: add your demo and it appears on everyone’s screen in a few seconds.

troubleshooting: Your name doesn’t show up: wait a few seconds, or refresh the page.
“Already on the board”: someone added the same name and project. Ask Dana to edit it.
Need a screen, a mic or a phone line for your demo? Tell Dana before the demos start.
